skill.displayName: Unified LLM Gateway - One API for 70+ AI models. Route to GPT, Claude, Gemini, Qwen, Deepseek, Grok and more
skill.summary: Unified LLM Gateway - One API for 70+ AI models. Route to GPT, Claude, Gemini, Qwen, Deepseek, Grok and more with a single API key.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of OpenClaw LLM Router: a unified gateway for 70+ LLMs with one API key.
- OpenAI-compatible API for chat, vision analysis, model comparison, and function calling.
- Built-in cost optimization, fallback, and model switching features.
- Unified billing and key management for easier integration.
- Supports major model families: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI, Alibaba, Deepseek, and more.
- Python client and CLI tool provided for quick integration and testing.
